note: Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting improvements.
title: Decadal average: Annual economic damages from storms as a share of GDP
subtitle: Damages are expressed as a share of gross domestic product (GDP). Decadal figures are measured as the annual average over the subsequent ten-year period. Storms include tornadoes, hailstorms, thunderstorms, sandstorms, blizzards, and extreme wind events.
